caseStudy.subtitle: Premium Fashion Shopping App for Men, Women & Kids — Android & iOS
highlights: Dedicated brand app for Monte Carlo’s full catalogue
Curated collections for men, women and kids
Monte Carlo, Rock.it, Luxuria and Home brands in one app
Secure checkout with UPI, cards and wallets
Clean, fast and on-brand shopping experience
caseStudy.overview:
Monte Carlo – Online Shop is a mobile app by Monte Carlo Fashions that brings its trendy urban wear to customers throughout India.

With both men’s and women’s collections, the app delivers premium apparel — jackets, jeans, shirts, t-shirts, tops, sweaters and more — through a dedicated digital shopping experience.
caseStudy.goal: Extend the Monte Carlo brand experience into a dedicated mobile channel — curated collections, easy category access, a fast and secure checkout and a consistent premium brand identity for shoppers across India.

audiences.title: Brand-loyal shoppers
audiences.text: Customers who want Monte Carlo’s latest styles without going through general marketplaces.

audiences.title: New online buyers
audiences.text: Shoppers across India outside the reach of Monte Carlo’s physical stores.

problems: Traditional in-store models limit reach to regionally local customers.
Online fashion platforms often lack brand-specific premium quality assurance and consistency.
Users face friction discovering brand collections through general marketplaces.
Mobile purchase flows can struggle with performance, clarity and brand identity.
Brand-loyal customers lacked a dedicated mobile presence with the full catalogue.

solutions.title: Dedicated Brand App
solutions.text: Monte Carlo’s brand experience extended into its own digital channel.

solutions.title: Curated Collections
solutions.text: Men, women and kids collections under one app for easier discovery.

solutions.title: Clean Browsing
solutions.text: Easy category access and product pages that stay true to the brand’s style.

solutions.title: Secure by Design
solutions.text: No data shared with third parties and data encrypted in transit.

solutions.title: Optimised Performance
solutions.text: Fast browsing and shopping for customers across India.

items.caption: Splash, Create Account, Home Range, Settings, Home, Top Selling
Product Details, Loyalty Points, Checkout, Season Trends, Account, Collections
Add Address, Top Selling, Notifications, Wishlist, Home, My Credits

results.label: Helped Monte Carlo move from purely offline to omnichannel retail and reach more customers
A brand-centric shopping experience that stands apart from general marketplace apps
Live on Google Play and the App Store
Direct access to the newest styles plus loyalty points that keep shoppers coming back

caseStudy.techNote: Flutter for a seamless cross-platform mobile experience, Node.js for APIs, user management and real-time data, React.js for the admin dashboard and MongoDB for flexible, scalable data storage.

caseStudy.subtitle: Personalised Food Delivery App Connecting Users to Their Favourite Restaurants
highlights: Smart filters and curated restaurant recommendations
Personalised meal suggestions from order history
Clean, minimal UI for quick browsing and ordering
Saved favourites and one-tap repeat orders
Join as a restaurant or delivery partner
caseStudy.overview:
Taste Food is a modern food delivery app crafted to bring users closer to their favourite restaurants and cuisines.

With a focus on personalisation and user delight, it offers a smooth and flavourful experience that goes beyond conventional food delivery platforms — from intuitive browsing to real-time tracking.
caseStudy.goal: Design a user-centric food delivery app with smart filters, curated recommendations and personalised suggestions — making it quick to find the right meal, simple to order and easy to come back for more.

audiences.title: Food lovers
audiences.text: Users who want their favourite meals and restaurants in a few taps.

audiences.title: Restaurants & delivery partners
audiences.text: Local and niche restaurants and riders who join the platform from the app.

problems: Most food delivery apps offer a generic and repetitive user experience.
Limited personalisation makes it hard to find favourite or suitable meals quickly.
No curated suggestions or intelligent recommendations for users.
Navigation and browsing can feel cluttered and overwhelming.

solutions.title: Smart Filters
solutions.text: Curated restaurant recommendations and filters to find the right meal fast.

solutions.title: Personalisation
solutions.text: Meal suggestions based on user preferences and order history.

solutions.title: Minimal UI
solutions.text: Clean screens for easy browsing, selection and ordering.

solutions.title: Convenience Features
solutions.text: Saved favourites, live tracking and repeat orders.

results.label: Tailored food recommendations, unlike many generic delivery platforms
Local and niche restaurants reach the right audience through smart listing and filters
A smooth, enjoyable ordering experience that encourages loyalty
Live on Google Play and the App Store

caseStudy.subtitle: Inventory, Sales & Marketing App for Distributors, Salespeople and Individuals
highlights: Custom modules for distributors, salespeople, individuals and marketing
Real-time stock levels and order tracking
Route master and daily route planning for field sales
Quotations, forecasts, invoices, ledgers and ERP orders
Wallet balances and construction planning for individuals
Promotion and product-demand insights for marketing teams
caseStudy.overview:
The CICO mobile app is a complete inventory management platform built to streamline the work of distributors, salespeople, individual users and marketing teams.

With a custom module for each role, CICO removes operational inefficiencies and gives everyone one place to manage stock, plan routes, serve customers and gain marketing insights.
caseStudy.goal: Design and build a mobile-first platform that unifies inventory management, sales tracking, route planning and marketing intelligence in one intuitive interface — with real-time insights and simpler workflows that improve productivity and customer experience.

audiences.title: Distributors
audiences.text: Manage inventory, place and track orders and see product insights.

audiences.title: Salespeople
audiences.text: Handle routes, customers, quotations, forecasts and invoices on the move.

audiences.title: Individuals
audiences.text: Browse distributors and products, manage a wallet and plan construction needs.

audiences.title: Marketing teams
audiences.text: Manage promotions, track item requests and analyse product demand.

problems: Inventory and operations were fragmented across different user groups.
Distributors found it hard to track real-time stock levels and manage orders.
Salespeople needed one system for routes, customers, quotations, invoicing and forecasts.
Individuals lacked tools for construction planning, product browsing and wallet-based ordering.
Marketing teams struggled to collect insights and align campaigns with real demand.

solutions.title: Distributor Dashboards
solutions.text: Inventory tracking, real-time order updates and performance analytics.

solutions.title: Field Sales App
solutions.text: Distributors, routes, inventory, customer queries, quotations and invoicing in one place.

solutions.title: Individual Module
solutions.text: A lightweight interface to browse distributors, manage inventory and track wallet balances.

solutions.title: Marketing Insights
solutions.text: Dashboards for promotions, product demand, item requests and approved inventory lists.

results.label: Distributors, salespeople, individuals and marketing teams on one platform
Live stock levels and order updates help distributors plan better
Tailored tools for each role removed redundant workflows
Integrated analytics help marketing teams get more from promotions

caseStudy.techNote: ReactJS for a dynamic web interface, Flutter for a seamless cross-platform mobile app, .NET for a secure and scalable backend and MySQL for efficient data storage.
